titleEn: How babies are born knowing the difference between day and night
titleZh: 婴儿为何天生就能感知昼夜差别？
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: Before a baby sees its first sunrise, it is already receiving signals about day and night. Melatonin, a hormone released mainly at night, can pass from the mother through the placenta. The placenta supplies the developing foetus with oxygen and nutrients.
paragraphs.zh: 在婴儿看到第一个日出之前，他已经在接收关于白天和黑夜的信号。褪黑激素是一种主要在夜间释放的激素，可以从母亲通过胎盘传递。胎盘为发育中的胎儿提供氧气和营养。

paragraphs.en: This may help explain interest in a Japanese study of 31,528 mothers and children. It found a link between working night shifts during pregnancy and possible developmental difficulties in children at age four. But it could not show that night work caused those difficulties.
paragraphs.zh: 这或许有助于解释人们对日本一项针对31,528名母亲和孩子的研究的兴趣。该研究发现，怀孕期间上夜班与孩子4岁时可能出现的发育障碍之间存在联系。但该研究无法证明夜班会导致这些障碍。

paragraphs.en: Researchers compared women who did not work night shifts, women who stopped between two pregnancy surveys, and women who reported night shifts at both surveys. Working just one night shift a month counted as night work. The study did not examine whether more frequent shifts carried greater risks.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员比较了不上夜班的女性、在两次怀孕调查之间停下来的女性以及在两次调查中都上夜班的女性。每月只上一次夜班也算夜班。这项研究没有调查更频繁的轮班是否会带来更大的风险。

paragraphs.en: Children whose mothers reported night shifts at both stages had a 29% to 34% higher relative risk of being flagged for possible difficulties with communication, fine motor skills (such as picking up small objects) or social skills, compared with children whose mothers did not work nights.
paragraphs.zh: 与母亲不上夜班的孩子相比，母亲在两个阶段都上夜班的孩子被标记为可能存在沟通困难，精细运动技能（如捡起小物体）或社交技能的相对风险高出29%至34%。

paragraphs.en: That does not mean a third of these children had difficulties. Across all groups, about 13% of children were flagged for a possible difficulty in at least one area.
paragraphs.zh: 这并不意味着这些孩子中有三分之一有困难。在所有组中，大约13%的孩子被标记为至少在一个领域可能存在困难。

paragraphs.en: Parents answered questions about their children’s abilities. These were screening checks, not medical diagnoses. A flagged result means a child might need further assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 家长们回答了关于他们孩子能力的问题。这些是筛选检查，而不是医学诊断。标记的结果意味着孩子可能需要进一步的评估。

paragraphs.en: The study had limitations. Researchers did not know exactly how many nights the women worked, how demanding their jobs were or why some stopped working nights.
paragraphs.zh: 这项研究也有局限性。研究人员并不知道这些女性到底工作了多少个晚上，她们的工作要求有多高，以及为什么有些人不上夜班了。

paragraphs.en: Researchers also looked at sleep duration. The link between night work and developmental screening results appeared stronger among women who reported sleeping at least ten hours. But only 80 women both continued working nights and reported that much sleep. This finding is uncertain and does not show that sleeping longer is harmful.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员还研究了睡眠时间。在睡眠时间至少为10小时的女性中，夜间工作与发育筛查结果之间的联系似乎更强。但只有80名女性既持续夜间工作，又报告了那么多睡眠。这一发现是不确定的，也没有表明睡眠时间过长是有害的。

paragraphs.en: The study also cannot tell us whether stopping night shifts would reduce any risk.
paragraphs.zh: 这项研究也不能告诉我们停止夜班是否会降低任何风险。

paragraphs.en: How babies learn about day and night
paragraphs.zh: 婴儿如何学习白天和黑夜

paragraphs.en: One possible explanation involves the body’s internal clock. This controls daily patterns in sleep, hormones and other processes. Before birth, the internal clock is still developing, so signals from the mother may help tell day from night.
paragraphs.zh: 一个可能的解释是人体内部的生物钟。它控制着睡眠、激素和其他过程的日常模式。在出生之前，内部生物钟仍在发育，因此来自母亲的信号可能有助于区分白天和黑夜。

paragraphs.en: Night work can disturb this timing. Even when someone gets enough sleep, sleeping during the day and staying awake at night can put their routine out of step with their body clock. Light and meal times can affect it too.
paragraphs.zh: 夜间工作会扰乱这种时间安排。即使有人得到了足够的睡眠，白天睡觉，晚上保持清醒也会使他们的日常生活与他们的生物钟不同步。光照和用餐时间也会影响它。

paragraphs.en: Animal research offers clues about how these signals reach a foetus in the womb. In a 2025 rat study, researchers found that substances from the mother’s food rose and fell throughout the day in an area of the unborn rat’s brain that would later help control its body clock. This happened before the clock was fully working.
paragraphs.zh: 动物研究为这些信号如何到达子宫中的胎儿提供了线索。在2025年的一项大鼠研究中，研究人员发现，母亲食物中的物质在未出生的大鼠大脑中的一个区域全天都在上升和下降，该区域后来将帮助控制其生物钟。这发生在生物钟完全工作之前。

paragraphs.en: In a 2026 mouse study, researchers gave pregnant mice a stress-related hormone at different times of day. The timing changed daily rhythms in their developing offspring and the placenta.
paragraphs.zh: 在2026年的一项小鼠研究中，研究人员在一天中的不同时间给怀孕的小鼠注射与压力相关的激素，时间的安排改变了它们发育中的后代和胎盘的日常节律。

paragraphs.en: These studies suggest that food-related substances and hormones may help pass information about time from mother to foetus. But they do not show whether this explains the Japanese findings or happens in the same way in humans.
paragraphs.zh: 这些研究表明，与食物有关的物质和激素可能有助于将时间信息从母亲传递给胎儿。但它们并没有表明这是否解释了日本的研究结果，还是以同样的方式发生在人类身上。

paragraphs.en: What early light exposure can tell us
paragraphs.zh: 早期曝光可以告诉我们什么

paragraphs.en: Other mouse studies have tested whether the amount of daylight during early life affects body clocks later on.
paragraphs.zh: 其他的老鼠研究已经测试了生命早期的日照量是否会影响以后的生物钟。

paragraphs.en: Mice raised under long, summer-like days developed different patterns of activity in their brain clocks from mice raised under short, winter-like days. Some differences remained after the lighting changed.
paragraphs.zh: 在长时间的夏日环境中饲养的小鼠，其大脑生物钟的活动模式与在短时间的冬日环境中饲养的小鼠不同。

paragraphs.en: Another study exposed mice to different day lengths from pregnancy until weaning. Even after they were put on the same light and dark schedule, mice raised under longer days spent more time asleep during daylight hours.
paragraphs.zh: 另一项研究将小鼠从怀孕到断奶期间暴露在不同的日照时间中。即使在相同的光照和黑暗时间表下，在较长日照时间下长大的小鼠在白天的睡眠时间也更多。

paragraphs.en: These experiments suggest that early light patterns can have lasting effects on mice. But seasonal changes in daylight are very different from working night shifts, and the findings cannot tell us whether human babies are affected in the same way.
paragraphs.zh: 这些实验表明，早期的光照模式可能会对小鼠产生持久的影响。但白天的季节变化与夜班工作有很大不同，这些发现无法告诉我们人类婴儿是否受到同样的影响。

paragraphs.en: Timing signals may also continue after birth. Breast milk contains melatonin, and its levels change through the day. In a small 2026 trial involving 60 premature babies, those given expressed milk at the same time of day it had been collected spent longer in quiet sleep by the time they left hospital. The researchers did not look at longer-term development.
paragraphs.zh: 出生后，定时信号也可能继续存在。母乳中含有褪黑激素，其水平每天都在变化。在2026年的一项涉及60名早产儿的小型试验中，那些在一天中的同一时间获得乳汁的婴儿在离开医院时，安静睡眠的时间更长。研究人员没有观察长期的发展。

paragraphs.en: Scientists are still learning how babies receive signals about day and night. The Japanese study raises useful questions about supporting pregnant night workers, including whether more flexible working hours could help. But it cannot establish that disrupted body clocks caused developmental difficulties, and it gives parents no reason to fear that an occasional sleepless night will harm their child.
paragraphs.zh: 科学家们仍在研究婴儿是如何接收白天和黑夜的信号的。日本的这项研究提出了一些关于支持怀孕的夜班工作者的有用问题，包括更灵活的工作时间是否会有所帮助。但它不能确定生物钟紊乱会导致发育障碍，而且它也没有理由让父母担心偶尔的不眠之夜会伤害他们的孩子。
